lines.t: Who will you stand with when the silence falls?
When the light divides the shadow from the wall?
Not what you hold, not what you prove,
But who you choose — that shapes all you do.
For every road begins in the heart,
And every step reveals who you are.
Who you choose, not what you choose,
Is the answer calling through.
For every deed is born of one,
The heart you've chosen to follow through.
Choose the True One, and you will see,
What freedom means in purity.
Those who turn, and seek another name,
Have chosen self, enclosed in flame.
Their will their guide, their pride their crown,
Yet in their gain, their souls drown.
But mercy waits beyond the door,
The voice of Love calls evermore.
Who you choose, not what you choose,
Is the answer calling through.
For every deed is born of one,
The heart you've chosen to follow through.
Choose the True One, and you will see,
What freedom means in purity.
Not by strength, nor by choice alone,
But by the truth that you make your own.
Lay down self, let heaven rise,
And see the world through holy eyes.
Who you choose, not what you choose,
Is life or loss — the path you use.
Choose the One who first chose you,
And all you do will be made new.
For who you choose defines your way,
Eternal night or endless day.
